old: Tanker convoy beef stew and damper

dish.n: Tanker run beef and onion stew with mash
dish.note: Chuck steak, onion and carrot stewed dark and thick, on buttery mash.
dish.how: Brown 800g diced chuck steak in 2 tbsp oil in batches, then soften 3 sliced onions and 2 diced carrots in the same pot. Return the beef with 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, 500ml beef stock and 2 bay leaves, cover and simmer on low for 2 hours until tender. Boil 1kg peeled potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk, and serve the stew over the mash.

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onions and carrots in the same pot.
Return the beef with the paste, Worcestershire sauce, stock and bay leaves, cover and simmer low.
Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash with the butter and hot milk.
Spoon the stew over the mash.

dish.make_ahead: Better made the day before and reheated
